title: [BUG] How is this possible to be at 62% opus for a week when using for few hours with 5 code files - Max Plan 20x
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I am using the latest version of Claude Code

### What's Wrong?

Your usage limit has a big issue as it does not make any sense to use that much when using it just for few hours and mostly to review 5 files of code. You have to fix this issue as the usage you are providing there is like for normal pro account which does not make any sense. Also 20% usage just to review diffs with sonnet 4.5 when i use another competitor who is doing the full coding did not reach this usage it makes me think a lot!!!! Please address this issue as soon a possible and thank you....

### What Should Happen?

Fix the rate limit properly
